svg.title: Windows idle memory usage: Keeby and reeb
svg.desc: Idle working set: Keeby 502.4 MB; reeb 132.9 MB. Reeb uses 73.5% less resident RAM in the supplied Windows benchmark. Ten seconds to settle, then median of five samples. Reported on 23 Oct 2026. Both bars use the same scale and zero baseline.
svg.text: Windows · idle working set · lower is better
